notes.title: Patch 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
Hey, Gatewalkers! 😄

We are happy to announce that we released Patch 1.2 today!

First, thank you all for your encouragement and feedback 💜 We have read everything you posted on Discord, Steam, and other social media platforms. Your insights were valuable and gave us another perspective on things. In response to your messages, we'd like to present the Patch 1.2.

Below you will find a list of new features, improvements and fixes: ⚔️

[olist]
[*] [b]Multiple character slots[/b] 
Each player will be able to create up to three characters on the server as well as three characters offline (more on that later). So you can create 6 characters in total!   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/cd3a9f743b28856b123019b6ac04f02ee2c3d539.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Offline mode[/b]
During character selection, you will be able to toggle between Online and Offline mode. You can create up to three characters in each of the modes you choose. It is possible to play without connecting to a server in offline mode, however you should be aware that offline characters are saved locally. As a result, you can only play these characters by yourself (it is not possible to join a party).

It is worth mentioning that offline characters will be saved in STEAM CLOUD, so even if you change your computer or switch to the STEAM DECK, the character will be saved on your STEAM account (unless you disable synchronization).

[*] [b]Matchmaking[/b]
The mechanism operates by comparing the character's number of progress points (so people with similar character development parameters are paired first). As a result, when fighting together in the game, individuals who join you should have similar strength.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f27ea77e1cf77606006fe41f850aeb8391858537.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]In-game chat[/b]
We understand that not everyone wants to join a Discord server to communicate with friends. As a result, we are going to incorporate in-game text chat for the party players. So you should find it easier to coordinate your actions, such as when everyone is ready to embark on the expedition during crafting etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/7d9c70b28abb25a51866c265b0e9c7457a83a683.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Combat flow changes[/b]
We realize that some of you find fighting to be a little clunky. This is a complex area, but measures will be taken to make it more fluent. In fact, we intend to add two features that will assist you while playing:
[list]
[*] [b]auto-attack[/b] - when you hold the main attack button, your character will continue to attack (no more neverending clicking)
[*] [b]skill queue[/b] - some of you may have encountered issues while casting your abilities too fast one after another (casting second spell before the first one finished). This usually results in no second spell being executed at all.  Typically, in games such as MOBAs and/or aRPGs, the game remembers what you clicked in the short period of time and attempts to fluently replay the sequence of casted skills to fit your pattern. We've added this now, and we think it will significantly improve the game flow.
[/list]

[*] [b]Character reset[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/321a8e62df4664cbcd9a7eec85109f079e5e11af.jpg[/img]
In order to do so, you need to go to Ursula Tragar (Librarian) and ask her to reset your progress. Please take into account that the cost is higher if you have more progress points to reset. This will allow us to scale the reset cost based on the place where you are in the storyline.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/071da68a34b12a2c6c206228749d587df20dbcaa.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

⚙️ List of improvements, changes and fixes in Patch 1.2:🛠️
 [list]
[*]  SnowBerries are now usables.
[*]  Laturi can now be skinned and drops meat.
[*]  Skills cast directly on players ignore cloaked characters.
[*]  Camera shake on landing Added.
[*]  Indicator on first jump added and health bars removed for Etcher T5
[*]  Surian Assassin skill changed from Ice to Toxic. Adds a new effect after the invisibility skill.
[*]  New skill in longsword.
[*]  Slowing Gate, a new rectangular shaped indicator
[*]  Extended IceSurianShamanBoss RainOfIcicle animations
[*]  Increased the height of Toxic Mantis projectiles.
[*]  Added missing foot sounds to all objectives in the world of sky rocks
[*]  If we are on an expedition and you have a quest in another, specific expedition, the panel on the right will display a red message.
[*]  Re-casting the skill at the wall now fires in the right direction
[*]  RootmanSeed reworked to match the description.
[*]  Restored the T6 and T7 Toxic Caves on the Toxic World and added a warning window when entering a Toxic Cave.
[*]  Balance Change to longsword. Base damage buff for Swing 83=>93, and focused version of Swing 101=>116. Base damage buff for Shielding Swing 315=>360 without focus and 365 =>420 with focus full stacked.
[*]  Changed the cost of repairing broken equipment. The cost of repairing a 0% durability item has been reduced from 50% to 35% of the basic and advanced resources needed to craft this item.
[*]  Removed the shovel hovering above the machine on the balcony.

[*]  Fixed an issue where drones would remain greyed out in the inventory until moved to another slot or dropped on the ground.
[*]  Fixed an issue where multiple turrets would spawn on top of each other in the Toxic Refinery objective.
[*]  Fixed an issue where the ancient ruins forest objectives T3, T4, and T6 were showing uncollectable trees with incorrect descriptions.
[*]  Fixed an issue where parts of the Hatchet's Rage skill dealt normal damage instead of elemental damage on elemental hatchets.
[*]  Fixed an issue where "Purifying Catalyst" would not consume elemental effects without activating a coop combo.
[*]  Fixed an issue where the Service Drone mob was trying to heal the objective Hive.
[*]  Fixed an issue where if a mob died while being healed by a service drone, the service drone would get stuck in the healing animation.
[*]  Fixed an issue where the Iron Mine challnege objective objective would spawn facing a wall
[/list]

We hope these changes are making your game experience better! Let us know what you think!

[url=discord.gg/8Tn76pT][img]https://i.imgur.com/36gkSKj.gif[/img][/url]
(click on the banner above)

Cheers!
Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is coming! Progress reset and more...
notes.content:
Hey there, Gatewalkers! 😄

Today, we'd like to tell you more about the upcoming patch, 1.2.0. But first, let us remind you what we are adding in this BIG UPDATE:
[list]
[*] Multiple character slots
[*] Offline mode
[*] Matchmaking
[*] In-game chat
[*] Combat flow changes
[*] Character progression reset
[/list]

Today we will focus more on the character progression reset system as well as we will discuss online and offline characters feature. 

First and foremost, thank you all for your support and feedback 💜. Now let us dive into the specifics.

[h3]Character progression reset[/h3]
We know that some of you play Gatewalkers for a while and, after making some choices are not fully satisfied with the builds. Therefore we believe it would be good if you have a choice to reset your character progress points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/321a8e62df4664cbcd9a7eec85109f079e5e11af.jpg[/img]

In order to do so, you need to go to Ursula Tragar (Librarian) and ask her to reset your progress. Please take into account that the cost is higher if you have more progress points to reset. This will allow us to scale the reset cost based on the place where you are in the storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1b05089a40ca12d441c1ac690f953ba1d1762ee9.jpg[/img]

After confirming the reset, the game will log your character out (some systems need to reload to make it all possible). After it, you will not have previously unlocked progress nodes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/17dc5964ec5bef0c4c8162b92f46a16e54c82184.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/071da68a34b12a2c6c206228749d587df20dbcaa.jpg[/img]

,and it all! You can reallocate all previously spent progress points again! We hope you will like this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/7edfb15815e607ad45145daee055866fbe9ca1fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1295ef35a1d6573482d644ced759069f3097802e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Characters for online and offline mode[/h3]
Based on your feedback and also to prepare the game for console ports, we think that offline mode is just a MUST-HAVE. So we have made some changes to the character creation screen, and also we are incrementing the number of CHARACTER SLOTS TO THREE:
[list]
[*] we have increased the number of character slots to 3 for online mode - so you can create three characters and therefore be in different places in the storyline (e.g. when you are playing with your friends)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9159c9f9652fb39224f95b82193dc9f54efe75c1.jpg[/img]

[*] we have added extra three character slots for offline mode - so in total, you can have six characters. Be aware that offline characters are not stored on servers, so you can only play solo with them, but still, we know that some of you just wish to be able to play alone without an internet connection, so this makes it possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/5469c0cac87374571c4c11ebc0ea4544dcade09d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

Thank you once more for reading our news feed, and remember its still work-in-progress. 

[b]Also, if you like playing Gatewalkers, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam.Have fun! [/b]

[url=discord.gg/8Tn76pT][img]https://i.imgur.com/36gkSKj.gif[/img][/url]
(click on the banner above)

Cheers!
Gatewalkers Dev Team

Once you have selected the option that suits you, you either have to wait for new players to join your game, or you are taken to join someone else's game.

So you should find it easier to coordinate your actions, such as when everyone is ready to embark on the expedition during crafting etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/7d9c70b28abb25a51866c265b0e9c7457a83a683.jpg[/img]

We're also considering starting a global chat, but we haven't made a final decision yet.

[*] [b]Combat flow changes[/b]
We realize that some of you find fighting to be a little clunky. This is a complex area, but measures will be taken to make it more fluent. In fact, we intend to add two features that will assist you while playing:

This usually results in no second spell being executed at all.  Typically, in games such as MOBAs and/or aRPGs, the game remembers what you clicked in the short period of time and attempts to fluently replay the sequence of casted skills to fit your pattern. We've added this now, and we think it will significantly improve the game flow.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12
notes.content:
Good Day, Brave Gatewalkers!

We have just launched a new Patch 😊!

Okay, here is a list of changes we have made. Quick reminder 👉 [b]verify your game files[/b] after downloading the patch to ensure that the game runs smoothly.

[*] Fixed an issue that prevented inventory items from being reorganized while playing on a gamepad
[*] Fixed the position of the Ancient Hybrid mob's health bar

[*] Fixed an issue where interacting with the lightning rod in the Volarian village in the Ancient Machine Schema quest would automatically unlock the T4, T5, and T6 lightning rods. [*] The character now rotates towards the secret chest when interacting with it

[*] Added component tooltips to the repair window 
[*] Now you can preview component tooltips while playing on a gamepad
[*] Now the lightning rod hint in Sky Rocks only appears after obtaining the lightning rod recipe.
[*] Added elemental FX on the second dagger in each weapon version
[*] Added FX invulnerability on Volarian Tomb Priest when it transforms into a new form

[*] Volarian Tomb Priest no longer disappears immediately upon death
[*] Improved the Ice Wisp skill

[*] Fixed a bug in the Toxic T7 cave that caused the chest to drop loot behind itself to a place inaccessible to the player
[*] Fixed a bug in Elder Monkey T3 mission where there were 2 pumps instead of 3
[*] Rebalanced objective types across all worlds to make them more diverse
[*] Added Snake boss T3 to Toxic random worlds
[*] Fixed description and rift in the ground in the Snake Boss T3 lair.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.content:
Hi there, Gatewalkers!

Today we launch a new patch and we have to say - we made a lot of changes and improvements! Thanks to you we can make Gatewalkers even more fun! Also, we are taking your ideas very seriously, so you can expect that we will implement some of them in the future 😎 But for now, check out what we did in this patch!

[b]💜 If you like playing Gatewalkers please consider leaving a positive review on Steam 💜[/b]

👉 Please [b]verify your game files[/b] after downloading the patch to ensure that the game runs smoothly.

[*] Change in boss kills achievements. Now when playing in coop, you don’t have to kill the boss yourself - killing a boss by a partymate also counts.
[*] The outlines of items that are deep in the background no longer display.
[*] New Elana portrait
[*] Added rewards for completing coop objectives
[*] Critical strike sound has been modified.
[*] Reduced chance of finding an Ancient Cave in all biomes
[*] Added metallic foot sounds to the Toxic Ancient Lab objective
[*] Added navigation to the password terminal in the Toxic Ancient Lab, now the player can’t go through the terminal.
[*] Added missing textures in the Volarian Hunter attack.
[*] Balancing Targe Shield's passive aura. Now grants 90 and 160 (from T5) defense buff and the Targe Shield skill now works on allies as well.
[*] Fixed a bug in some T5, T6, T7 caves that caused the Etcher T5 mob to work incorrectly.
[*] Fixed all treasure detector cases when the detector was showing a place off the map.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the treasure detector to behave strangely when placed close to a chest.
[*] Fixed [NO TRANSLATION] bug in Ancient Hybrid boss name.
[*] Fixed descriptions in Broadsword's effects when consuming Prey Mark.
[*] Ancient Orb kill goal (achievement) has been extended to include Ancient Turret
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Ancient Berserker to display a circle indicating his aggro range when fighting.
[*] Fixed an issue where the levers in the Guild Training Room had the "Talk" interaction
[*] Added ancient technology fragment resources to all Fire worlds.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Toxic Ancient Lab objective where mobs spawned suspended in the air.
[*] Fixed navigation in the Toxic Ancient Lab objective that allowed ignoring locked doors when the player was walking on the edge of the objective.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to find Enlighted Flame Ruler in T7 fire worlds.
[*] Fixed missing collisions in the Toxic Ancient Lab
[*] Fixed text overlapping on the other UI elements in the crafting window.
[*] Fixed a bug where Force Staff T5 Toxic Epic would not unlock after unlocking Force Staff T5 Toxic and Force Staff T5 Epic
[*] Fixed issue with inconsistent damage values on rings, when changing gear or while under effects of damage buffs (Diversionist Ring Toxic and Heat)
[*] Fixed the bug with the automatic change of the main passive skill when going between the guild and the expedition
[*] Fixed a bug with no snow to collect on some T6 Ice Worlds.
[*] Fixed Spell Swirl's hit count according to its description.
[/list]

That’s all for now! Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us. You can do this here on Steam (and other social media) but we encourage you to join our welcoming Discord community. Why? We check out the Discord server very often. Also, some players are already pros 😎 and they are helping others which is amazing (thank you guys!). That’s why you can get the fastest reply to your questions on Discord.

notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!

Here we go with another patch. Thanks to the newest changes your gaming experience will be much better!

We would like to thank you for reporting the bugs. Thanks to your engagement we are able to make this game better! We are also very happy to see how you are doing on Discord. A lot of you are finishing the game or having fun on higher tiers. We couldn’t be happier! 😊

👉 Please [b]verify your game files[/b] after downloading the patch to ensure that the game runs smoothly. 

[b]💜 If you like playing Gatewalkers please consider leaving a positive review on Steam 💜[/b]

🧰 Here is the list of fixes & improvements ⚙️ [list]
[*] Fixed a broadsword bug that caused performance issues and noticeable game stuttering in coop. The bug occurred while playing with a broadsword user
[*] Significantly lowered floor sounds and armor movement sounds
[*] Corrected image of the Toxic Essence Collector objective
[*] Improved the animation blend of the Smoker mob
[*] Fixed disappearing stones in Forest caves
[*] Fixed the effect of the agro modifier not working correctly
[*] Fixed a goal to become a party leader 
[*] Fixed a bug where in coop with a T6 broadsword and any offhand equipped, the offhand skills would not get the bonuses from the broadsword skill description
[*] Fixed an issue with the ability to duplicate items in clipboard mode with T7 item tracking enabled
[*] Fixed not working platform in Sky Rocks objective
[*] Fixed progress tree display bug (sometimes only the edge of the progress tree was visible)
[*] Fixed cave entrance in the Toxic World T7
[*] Fixed the name of the Fire world in the world console (from "Lava World" to "Fire World")
[*] Fixed an issue where the Toxic T7 treasure detector was pointing beyond the world border
[*] Fixed an issue where the Toxic T7 objective would spawn a giant elite Ancient Berserker
[*] Stage with carrying batteries (coop in the Ice World) now counts the amount of the batteries (“Transfer the batteries to the machine with the transporter (0/8”)
[*] Improved animation synchronization between Volarian Fire Wielder mob abilities.
[*] Improved "Deadly Mark" effect in Assassin's blades weapon when playing in coop
[*] Fixed second attack on Broadsword T6 and T7 to properly grant 300 defense when "Prey Mark" is consumed
[*] Meat and sandwich buffs rebalanced. Now low tier items give a smaller buff. 
[*] Fixed wrong effect name in "Burn wound remedy"
[*] Improved Diversionist Ring Heat and Diversionist Ring Toxic - now strength scales correctly with weapon strength and player modifiers. Also the effect has the same value as in the weapon description.

[*] “Cleanse” no longer removes positive effects.
[*] Improved the description of the Torch II upgrade.
[*] Improved visualization of Small Parasite's “Armor Up” ability.

That’s all for now! Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us. Your insights are very valuable.

[*] Gem tooltip now clarifies where they can be found

[*] Rebalanced Earth Hit daze effect to 25%
[*] Essence T7 bosses now have more HP
[*] Improved navigation around Ancient dungeon entrances
[*] Fixed the position of the Ancient Cape item on the player
[*] Speeded up the recovery of food and drink levels in the UI
[*] Improved stamina cost on Ax Hit skill on T5.

notes.title: Gatewalkers weaponry #3 - Spellsword
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers,

today we will introduce one of Gatewalker’s weaponry classics, the spellsword! The spellsword was already available in the beta tests, but we have tweaked some of its elemental and higher tier (T4+) versions. So even if some of you already wielded a spellsword, some of its mechanics have changed since then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c2fa01d475c9e38cc8ed0ade2a5d478e9aae9981.jpg[/img]

Spellswords, despite their appearance, are not cutting weapons. The core of the weapon is made using the technology of the Ancients. Gatewalkers interested in dealing medium-range, area attacks will find this weapon particularly interesting. Due to its shorter range, spellsword users have to stay closer to their targets than other magic weapon wielders. This inherent weakness is offset by a larger area of attack of its skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/bf62ec49089ef96da19e40f9f4ac5d9e7d478eee.jpg[/img]

[b]Sonic Wave[/b]: This simple attack is a wave of energy within a close-/medium-range. It hits every target in the area. Every once in a while, the spellsword charges itself. When it is charged, the next Sonic Wave will deal significantly more damage. Charged Sonic Waves will also have a larger area of attack when used with endgame spellswords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c4bd5ce554757220a8bcc192901f51d74e114f37.jpg[/img]

[b]Pillar[/b]: The caster gathers energy in a selected spot, and after a short delay, every target in the area will be struck by a pillar of raw power. This power will charge the next Sonic Wave if the caster chooses to be in the striking area of this skill. This secondary skill attack effect changes significantly with different elemental enchantments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/493754e0c80fa2e7481f941a756e0b851a1aaeb9.jpg[/img]

The key to maximizing damage with a spell sword is charging Sonic Waves often. To achieve this goal, one must consistently hit both oneself and the enemies with pillar spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/cd3f85802e5bcd4a79976a450e2d297c720316d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Spell Surge[/b]: A massive high-damage vortex of energy forms around the caster. The vortex deals bursts of damage to all targets for a short period. This spell’s secondary effects are affected by the weapon’s element the same way as the pillar spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/52b641a9364b70e2ee0694c098d6443da06b2b73.jpg[/img]

[b]Elemental modifications[/b]: The pillar’s and spell surge’s skills secondary effects change depending on the element ingrained into the core of the spellsword. 
Those effects are:
[list]
[*] Heat: More damage to enemies and damage buff for friendly targets.
[*] Shock: Interrupts and dazes enemies. Faster movement for caster and his allies.
[*] Cold: Slows down and stuns enemies. 
[*] Void: Weakness debuff for enemies that decreases their attack power and resistance.
[*] Toxic: Toxic poison that deals damage to enemies over a period of time.
[/list]
Also, remember, this is a one-handed weapon, so you can use it in combination with all shields and off-hand weapons like pistols or torches.

We hope you will like the weapon and try it out! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Ancient Hive
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!
 
One way of getting experience points and resources necessary to build probes is to accomplish Guild objectives. While playing Gatewalkers Beta, you had the chance to experience a few types of objectives, but today we want to show you a new one called the Ancient Hive. 
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9c121d5ca92ce21c35671753b7c3f636cebd3fac.jpg[/img]

The Ancient Hive objective works as follows:
1. Find one of three ancient hives on the map
2. Attack the hive

notes.title: BETA changelog
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers! 

We would like to share with you a list of changes and improvements we have made to Gatewalkers since the last alpha tests. You will be able to check them all in the upcoming BETA (February 3, 2021).

[olist]
[*] New things and mechanics:
[list]
[*] Solo combo - Players are able to use additional powerful spells if they cast other spells in the correct order.
[*] Player customization - New you can play as male or female. You also can choose between various types of heads, hairstyles, beards, and skin colors. Remember, it is still a work in progress, so expect more customization later.
[*] The main character has been redesigned:
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/bbb4fea54bf4395d6576f25edab8c5b92949dc38.jpg[/img]
[*] a new model (male and female)
[*] new armors (male and female versions)
[*] new animations per weapon type
[/list]
[*] New wound mechanics - Some bosses apply a special type of wound. These wounds give players negative effects and can be removed only using appropriate remedies (craftable from etc., herbs). 
[*] Conditional spells - Some amulets also give conditional spell, which is cast automatically when all casting conditions are met, e.g., players have very low HP.
[/list]
[*] Changed or redesign things and mechanics:
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9e672740710bd72748db93a8628be628d6374321.jpg[/img]
[*] Enchanting is now craftable in the laboratory near Victor Hemming.
[*] Levels in passive spells with chargeable spell 
[*] Graphical Progress tree redesign - Max item tier in Beta is T3.
[*] The amulets branch of the Progression Tree has changed.
[*] The rings branch of the Progression Tree has changed.
[*] New damage formula (with diminishing returns)
[*] New resist and defense logic
[*] Upgraded passive buffs from drinks and food
[/list]
[*] New languages in the game:
[list]
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese/Brazilian 
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] French
[/list]
[*] Background music for the following locations: main menu, Guild, Forest world, Toxic world, Ice world.

[*] New quest-line - "The Ancients archive," with a new boss to kill

[*] Some consumable items now have tiers to scale through the game (e.g., grenades and healing kits).

[*] Complete rework of UI/UX:
[list]
[*] improved readability and graphics
[*] new HUD
[*] new icons for new skills
[*] new party invite panel
[*] new inventory and statistic window
[*] new settings
[*] new progression and crafting windows
[*] ...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/0db7c240427d7c5572cc92e194fbdce0f295af35.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[*] QoL improvements:
[list]
[*] now it is possible to change room master
[*] better (more descriptive) tooltips
[*] starving and nutrition lost has been rebalanced
[*] now you are able to change your nickname in-game  
[*] the weight calculation has been fixed without roundings
[/list]
[*] Crafting:
[list]
[*] it is possible to repair broken items
[*] new or changed recipes for amulets and rings
[*] new recipes for remedies (with new herbs to find)
[/list]
[*] ... and many other minor improvements
[/olist]

[b]BE AWARE: Gatewalkers is still work-in-progress, so some things can and probably will be changed to the release. The quest-line, passive spells, character progression, have been adapted to Beta tests, so they do not represent the final shape.[/b]

Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: UI/UX improvement
notes.content:
The alpha tests of Gatewalkers have just finished, and once again, we would like to THANK YOU for your great feedback!

During the tests, we have read many opinions about what is working and what is not. The one thing that was pointed quite often was the quite "raw" UI. The idea behind such a basic UI was to create it fast and then check if the proposed layout is working for you. After that, we planned to make a new one based on your opinions. 

We are now ready to show you how we have approached creating a new UI/UX and what you can expect from it in the upcoming Beta (which [b]starts February 3, 2021[/b]).

The first and essential part of UI/UX is the HUD, which is almost always a visible part of the game. That is why we put special effort to refine it in terms of usability and readability. The previous one was a little bit too overwhelming at first glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/fbca8ca46a7517a5fa832a37b84f96ecedfde114.png[/img]
As you can see, we have redesigned the entire look and feel. Next, we will discuss some (not all) elements of the new UI.


[h2]MAIN BAR[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b521efd25f9d89ec08ff956ea526d4b0073c9a01.png[/img]
The main change involved moving all vital UI elements like HP/shield bar, stamina bar, and effects status bar close to the skill slots and quick slots. Thanks to that, it will be easier to manage all these different gameplay aspects at once, even when you are in combat. Let us take a closer look at each part of the main bar:
[list]
[*] (1) HP/Shield bar - Shows the level of your health points and shield points. Moreover, if you have a barrier, it also indicates how strong it is (more about barrier in the future).
[*] (2) Stamina bar - Indicates how many skills you can cast without resting
[*] (3) Skill slots bar - Here, you have all the available abilities that can be used during combat, based on your gear.
[*] (4) Quick slots bar - Quick items bar to which you can assign hotkeys. Quick slots makes it easier to use items during combat and exploration.
[*] (5) Active effects panel - Here, you can see all the effects that affect your character, both: positive and negative.
[*] (6) Passive skills and chargeable skill panel - A place where you can see what passive spells are now active and what chargeable ability is available to you. We will write more information about the mechanics behind passive skills and chargeable abilities in a future post.
[*] (7) The elemental power on a weapon - The icon shows what elemental power is enchanted on a weapon with information about the accompanying cooperative combo spell.
[*] (8) Solo combo spell - Description of the solo combo ability that is cast after executing an appropriate sequence of skills.
[*] (9) Crafting button - Opens the crafting window, where you can make the most important things that do not require a crafting station
[*] (10) Progress tree button - Opens the progress tree window, which allows you to progress your character in various ways: unlocking new recipes, unlocking new passive skills, unlocking new weapons with enchantments (coop combo) and weapons with the solo combo skill (solo combo). More on a new mechanic called solo combo in future posts.
[*] (11) Open inventory button
[/list]


[h2]INVENTORY AND STORAGE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ac273657554753cd76a9a76fcbab058e1cf652f4.png[/img]
An updated view of inventory and icons of items reflects the fantasy and sci-fi feel of Gatewalkers' world. 


[h2]CRAFTING STATION[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c2f3df9a25a085851cbfea0b61b0ae43e8f21a78.png[/img]
We have changed the crafting station panel to include all crucial aspects of items to create here. Also, we have made filter buttons more visible.


[h2]CHARACTER STATISTICS PANEL[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1b3d35645e3458f80685012aa7e62342383cf3c0.png[/img]
We have redesigned basic and advanced statistic panels to show essential data concerning your character's build more clearly.


[h2]RADAR[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9bc880e31f31e12878b9fdb08fd61779fd5a255b.png[/img]
The radar serves as a quick overview of the location of active quests and objectives. Button (1) allows you to get back to the Guild. The next two buttons open settings (2) and the map (3) of the expedition's current area. 


[h2]SURVIVAL PANEL[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b893ccb31b0b62432c4b431c3733268d35343b81.png[/img]
Here (on the left side of the screen), you can see icons representing hazards that players face during an expedition. In this example, in the forest world, you need to fight with hunger, dehydration, and insanity, All these elements are shown in the survival panel alongside information about the time of day.


[h2]PARTY PANEL[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/68be6e4d0676eb03b93f190cd276e2758cb33172.png[/img]
A new look of the party panel to track the HP/shield and stamina level of your party members. 


[h2]DIALOG WINDOW[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/defa12ecd569b32ed6299b6b971d340655f5ec5a.png[/img]
A new look of the dialog window.


[h2]SETTINGS WINDOW[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f672a70fd56e47de22b0aaeb44efc7becb654b10.png[/img]
We have expanded settings, so a new window includes new parameters to set.



To sum up, we have shown you changes in UI/UX, and we are eager to hear your feedback. Please remember that it is still a work in progress. 
Thank you for reading and be on the lookout for more information about Gatewalkers soon!

Best,
Gatewalkers Dev Team
